name: Jorgen
summary: Jorgen keeps watch beside the water at Stormwind's Valley of Heroes entrance. His quiet perch draws people with matters they cannot discuss openly.

sections.title: Eyes by the Water
sections.body: Jorgen keeps to the water just right of Stormwind's great entrance. Above him, statues of heroes look over the bridge, while he watches those who come and go below. People seeking information they want kept off the record can find a quiet contact there.

sections.title: A Tangled History
sections.body: Jorgen's past ties him to Elling Trias, a master cheese merchant who gathers intelligence, and Bishop DeLavey of the Cathedral of Light. When investigators seek a diplomat who disappeared after being sent to Theramore, Jorgen can point them in the right direction. Few local contacts know the way through such delicate inquiries, and Jorgen helps only when approached with care.

faq.answer: Jorgen waits beside the water in Stormwind's Valley of Heroes. Enter through the gates from Elwynn Forest, then head down to the water on the right side of the main bridge.

faq.q: Who is Jorgen connected to in Stormwind?
faq.answer: Jorgen has a history with Elling Trias, a prominent cheesemonger in the Trade District with covert connections, and Bishop DeLavey of the Cathedral of Light.

faq.q: What role does Jorgen play in the investigation of the missing diplomat?
faq.answer: Bishop DeLavey sends investigators to his old friend Jorgen with a letter during the search for the missing envoy. Jorgen grudgingly agrees to help, makes them swear to secrecy, and sends them to Elling Trias at Trias' Cheese with a sealed note.

faq.q: Is Jorgen affiliated with the Stormwind City Guard?
faq.answer: No. Jorgen works independently, away from the Stormwind City Guard's patrols along the canal banks, where people can speak out of earshot.

angles.text: Jorgen shows how whispers travel through Stormwind beneath its marble streets, with close ties to the covert work run through Trias' Cheese.
When official channels in Stormwind meet bureaucratic walls, street informants like Jorgen help track threats to the kingdom.
